name: Oviedo (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Oviedo (the Cross of the Angels on blue surrounded by the titles of the city, inscribed BENEMÉRITA).
history: The symbols of the concejo of Oviedo are the arms, showing the titles held by the city around the Cross of the Angels beneath a royal crown, and the flag, which is blue with the arms at the centre.

features.role: Oviedo arms — Cross of the Angels with the titles of the city
